I had a blood test at the beginning of July which stated I needed to book a routine appointment. Couldn’t get one on the phone so filled in the form online. Was text on the 10th to confirm I’d receive a link to book. Didn’t get this by the 22nd so I called up and explained my symptoms are worse and I’m really worried and while trying to explain more was interrupted multiple times.

I was offered an appointment but it clashed with travelling to a work meeting so I asked if I could have that time but a telephone appointment. I was told they can’t guarantee that time and they’d call at anytime between 9 and 1 which as I have to work, isn’t convenient. I was then told I would have to wait for the link which they are sending because I’m “in luck” which I don’t feel to be honest. Now have an appointment booked a month after I had my blood test meanwhile my symptoms are worsening and I am getting really worried.

Every time i deal with this surgery, it’s difficult. I really don’t understand how people get appointments unless you make it your full time job. In the meantime, my husband was asked to book an appointment via a link with no explanation. He did so thinking there would be an update for him and when attending, the doctors had no idea why he had been asked to book.

Really poor service. I understand the NHS is under a lot of pressure but empathy from staff and politeness costs nothing.",null,[0,237]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25aMFJrbENSSGhFZVVscmNuZEZhM0IzVnpGcFZYYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xf8cd3341e58f064f!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOnZ0RklCRHhEeUlrcndFa3B3VzFpVXc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25aMFJrbENSSGhFZVVscmNuZEZhM0IzVnpGcFZYYxAB&t=1&-VBM834KgswY1VyMTBLakhGeA&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi8g4OXzbCTAxVzHWMBHVq7LFMQoykIEygB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwi8g4OXzbCTAxVzHWMBHVq7LFMQ0pMFCBEoBQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCaHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUpJVWxsZlgxOWZSV2hFUkV0eGFIZHpWVkZLTTFWU2NtZEtPRUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEphTUVOYU9EUjNhSEZ6V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT205d1VtaGxPVXBQTmpBeFlYQTJWWFZQUTIwMVExRRAB",["0x0:0xf8cd3341e58f064f",null,1751358838687649,1751358838687649,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/106128319577179887260/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Tanya Palmer","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLefGSyNcUhfxd__AIoUnF-m3rlkBmFK4kVBBXfwhEOF_Q5=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/106128319577179887260?hl=en"],"106128319577179887260",null,5,1,null,[0,3,1],0,["5 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwi8g4OXzbCTAxVzHWMBHVq7LFMQ7LoGCBUoAA"]]]],null,"8 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["I’ve now had two separate occasions where a referral clinic asked me to pass a form to the surgery so I could obtain a prescription.
